summary: Snowboarder caught and buried in an avalanche on The Nose near Silverton while touring with a partner; hut staff saw the slide and helped with rescue, but the victim did not survive
location: The Nose, Middle Fork of Mineral Creek
responding_agency: San Juan County SAR + San Juan County Sheriff, Silverton Medical Rescue, La Plata County SAR, Silverton Avalanche School, CAIC, Silverton Mountain helicopter
notes: approx; pair touring, skier escaped debris
